qna_context.question: What should this survey ultimately help LearnSphere decide? Please describe the main decision in your own words, especially how the findings should guide the proposed VR, translation, career coaching, or productivity-tool features.
selected_option: Our product is an all-in-one, cloud-based project management and collaboration platform called 'ProjectPro'. It currently offers a range of features, including task assignment and tracking, team member onboarding and management, real-time file sharing and version control, automated workflows and approval processes, customizable dashboards and reporting, and integration with popular third-party tools such as Google Drive, Slack, and Trello. ProjectPro is designed to help teams of all sizes streamline their workflows, improve communication, and increase productivity. We are considering adding several new features to ProjectPro, including a built-in time tracking and billing system, a more advanced analytics and reporting module, and a mobile app for on-the-go access to project information. The new features will be designed to further enhance the platform's capabilities and make it an even more indispensable tool for teams and organizations.
